goal: Measure desktop resolution, permission, and popup classification tasks against local fixtures and live macOS where safe.

tasks.goal: Resolve a known local application by bundle id and verify the path exists.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains resolved: true and path is non-empty

tasks.goal: List installed applications and verify the result is a non-empty array.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains applications as an array with length > 0

tasks.goal: Check accessibility permission status; record honestly if unavailable.
tasks.skip_reason: requires macOS Accessibility permission; records skipped if unavailable

tasks.goal: Classify a fixture popup window and verify the classification is one of the expected types.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains classification and it is in [alert, dialog, notification, menu]

tasks.goal: Read a known system setting and verify the value type.
